page.title: Legal Department | Dr Otgen Clinic
page.description: Dr Otgen Clinic Legal Department provides information on patient rights, privacy, document processes and corporate legal communication requests.

hero.title: Transparent and Secure Communication in Legal Processes
hero.description: Information, document and communication requests of a legal nature related to Dr Otgen Clinic are reviewed within the framework of relevant records, patient rights, privacy principles and applicable legislation.

profiles.title: Professional Coordination in Legal Processes
profiles.description: Our Legal Department supports the coordinated review of document, communication, privacy and process requests related to the institution together with the relevant units.

people.name: Av. Çağatay Güler
people.description: Provides legal counsel and process follow-up on patient rights, personal data protection, contractual document processes and in-house legal coordination.

people.name: Av. Aslı Karakula
people.description: Supports communication and process follow-up with relevant units on patient rights, personal data protection, contractual document processes and in-house legal coordination.

support.title: What Can You Request Information About?

cards.title: Patient Rights and Communication Processes
cards.text: Communication requests of a legal nature related to patient rights and the service process are reviewed in line with relevant records.

cards.title: Personal Data and Privacy
cards.text: Personal data protection, privacy requests and related information processes are addressed within the framework of applicable regulations and in-house records.

cards.title: Consent, Contract and Document Processes
cards.text: Requests related to consent, contracts, applications or corporate document processes are reviewed in coordination with the relevant departments.

cards.title: Health Tourism Legal Coordination
cards.text: Document, communication and process requests that may arise within international patient services are reviewed within the framework of applicable legislation, record-keeping and authority.

steps.title: Submit Your Request
steps.text: Share your information, document or communication request related to a legal process via the form.

steps.title: Relevant Records Reviewed
steps.text: Your request is reviewed in line with the relevant transaction, document, unit and records.

steps.title: Information and Guidance
steps.text: Information and guidance deemed necessary within the process are shared through the relevant units.

security.title: Secure Information Sharing
security.description: Do not share identity numbers, passport details, card information, passwords, health data or other sensitive personal data via the form. If deemed necessary, the relevant information and documents will be requested through an appropriate communication channel.
